title: Mad Men - The Carousel (Higher Quality)
summary: The Kodak Carousel pitch scene from the Mad Men season finale, in which Don Draper sells nostalgia through a slide projector. It runs about three minutes.
why: HN holds it up as one of the best pitches ever, an example of selling feeling and nostalgia rather than features.

quote.text: Mad Men's Kodak presentation in season one is one of the best pitches I've seen.
